review: Independent six-file source review: compact utility pages and attachment status
resolved_findings: Route options Script observer was inside its own initializer closure; final observer is after Collapsible.show, like every other disclosure.
Unsupported ButtonVariant::Primary/unused imports were corrected by owner to pinned Default/valid imports; no dependency change required.
Accidental GUI Unicode mojibake was restored from the UTF-8 baseline; final GUI diff is limited to intended status, initial sizes and focused notice test.
Connect/Update endpoint-active checks are now derived outside the Connect users body, so closing the disclosure does not disable valid still-visible actions.
Blocking staged-options validation now renders outside the closed Connect users disclosure.
reviewed: Three UI files reorganize existing forms into default-closed pinned Ouroboros Collapsible sections with stable ID sources. Normal header Script observers are outside show initializers; disclosure clicks dispatch no worker command.

Virtual replica source/PID/options validation, selected stable slot, Start/Stop pending/revision guards and worker command construction are preserved. Compact row selection still uses exact Select replica N semantic label; stable identities remain available in details.

Macro errors, recording error and pending notice remain above disclosures. Per-user focus/pending retarget and recording/playback guards remain; closure-local file/timeline/generator command holders propagate the original worker action without losing it. Primary record/playback controls are on the first screen.

Graph unresolved/error/pending/queue suspension remain outside details. Apply retains explicit resolve/revision/pending guards and is distinct from queue Cancel. Connection categories, staged options, history, file operations and canvas hit labels retain command semantics; canvas height reduces320to220 without altering normalized node positions.

A new backend open emits Attaching and exactly one AttachmentFinished success/failure result; cached open/failure handling is retained. EventBus removes only matching retained progress, broadcasts completion without replaying it, and supervisor treats completion as telemetry rather than a command ACK.

GUI AttachmentNotice is independent of global command result and page controllers. Matching completion clears progress or stores its own failure notice; wrong-PID completion cannot clear it. Terminal events/new session clear it. Footer tooltip retains full failure detail; Script status mirrors displayed notice plus persistent result.
limits: Source-only approval, no Cargo/native/apps were run by this review. Producer checks/builds and independent native/pixel acceptance remain required before group completion.

Synthetic status/EventBus tests cover matching, failed and mismatched completion. Outstanding page-pending isolation is source-reviewed only, not directly simulated by those tests. Failed native open/pending races are not to be forced for this gate.

Density, contrast, actual whole-control visibility and primary/secondary action clarity remain actual-pixel judgment; source organization alone does not establish full UX/Ultra parity. No old algorithm, permissions or input-family acceptance is replaced.

verified: Agent recording summary includes current owner client and count with less redundant identity/prose. Idle actions emphasize Start; local recording exposes Stop, agent recording exposes Discard/Inspect, playback exposes Cancel. Existing rendered command predicates, pending assignment, recipient and worker actions remain.
Root follow-up leaves active power notices visible even during recording and only collapses the non-recording playback summary conditional. No routing/clip/permission behavior changes.

Macro state-dependent button helpers use valid pinned Default/Destructive/Outline variants and existing label/frame guards. Pixel fit, readability and action hierarchy remain independently unaccepted until corrected native originals are reviewed.

reviewed: Only VU UI code changes against the Macro-accepted producer. Start/Stop commands, stable selection, revision/pending guards, indices and target PID values remain unchanged.

Body width is capped to the actual clipped parent width after resize. Source/PID display strings are measured at Unicode scalar boundaries with a bounded 256-scalar prefix; underlying option ordering/selection and full labels retained for tooltip/widget metadata.
Replica state/PID/selection is a separate wrapping caption. Full identity and source identity are selectable break-anywhere text jobs at the visible width; label contents are not truncated.
No new observer, routing action, permission, schema or worker behavior; actual minimum readability and full ID access remain native original-pixel criteria.
limits: Source-only review; no app/Cargo launched. Hover/accessibility metadata and arbitrary long names are not part of the nine-observation native continuation.
